title: Prototype or mockup evidence

any: visual hierarchy cannot be decided from existing design rules
a novel interaction needs pre-implementation evidence
the user explicitly requests a mockup or prototype

skill_calls.when: prototype evidence must be reviewed against design intent

nodes.obligation: Create the smallest mockup or prototype needed to decide unresolved interaction or visual behavior.

tests.evidence: artifact covers named viewports, states, and decisions without being treated as runtime proof
tests.command_source: design artifact and visual review tooling

workline_policy: Usually merge into design; split only for an independently reviewed artifact or external handoff.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE when existing design rules and implemented patterns already decide the affected UI behavior.
repair: Review findings reopen only the affected prototype states or decision notes.
